title: Canonical complete settings for a new local coach reminder
description: Documentation/interchange schema for complete NEW settings after weekday normalization. reminder-set accepts partial patches of existing settings; read/merge and runtime validation remain authoritative. Existing untyped review entries are legacy custom/last7 and are deliberately not new-settings-valid. This schema does not confer consent, register a job or prove delivery. Timezone is supplied as the IANA --tz argument, not stored here; review_period is derived in gate output.

enabled.description: Explicit user choice; no default opt-in.

weekdays.description: Canonical sorted distinct weekdays: 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday. Runtime normalizes input duplicates.

pause_until.description: Timezone-aware pause expiry; null clears it.
